_: EvilCraft, from All the Mods 9's census (W4 R7, judged 2026-11-11). Bloody cobblestone is broken rock, a form of cobblestone, seen in the ground of the highlands, on a material no rule reads. Named alone, the one block that census judged, because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not.

Infested nether soul sand is the Nether's soul sand as EvilCraft lays it, seen in the soul sand valleys, and wears as the game's soul sand does, as sand; it is on a material no rule reads, and the rules refuse every block called soul. ATM9's census excluded it as ore and ATM10's judged it sand in 1.21.1; Xep, asked whether it should be sand in both, said yes (W4 R10, 2026-11-12), so it is named here as 1.21.1's file names it. Its infested netherrack and nether bricks were not judged and are left to the rules.
